title: Invariance of the single-complex comparison under nested source-open restriction
statement: Let f:X→S, f′:X′→S′, g:S′→S and g′:X′→X form a commutative square of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let K∈D(O_X), K′∈D(O_{X′}) and φ:L(g′)*K→K′ [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-pullback]. For open subschemes Z⊆W⊆X, put P=X′×_X W with projections p:P→X′ and q:P→W, f_W=f|W, f′_W=p composed with f′, K_W=L(W→X)*K, and K′_W=Lp*K′. Define φ_W:Lq*K_W→K′_W by the canonical pullback composition comparison Lq*L(W→X)*K≅L(q composed with W→X)*K=L(p composed with g′)*K≅Lp*L(g′)*K followed by Lp*φ [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. The ambient comparison b_Z [def-pc-single-complex-open-comparison] is invertible if and only if the comparison on the open (W→X)⁻¹Z computed in the restricted square (q,f′_W,f_W,g) with coefficient arrow φ_W is invertible. No cartesianness, quasi-coherence, compactness, affine-base, cover or local-isomorphism hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Construct e:A≅Z with Scheme.Opens.isoOfLE hZW. Compose pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso with the isomorphism induced by pullback.map along e to construct e′. Mathlib projection equations prove e′p_Z=rp and e′q_Z=te. No existence theorem supplies any scheme or coefficient data.

source.place: Tag 0DJ9 nested source-open coordinates; Mathlib Restrict and pullback pasting

proof.text: Construct α and β as composites of the selected derived pullback composition isomorphisms and equality isomorphisms. Apply the coefficient-coherence theorem to the explicit e′ and its projection equations. This identifies the twice-restricted coefficient arrow with the once-restricted arrow under α and β.

Apply source-coordinate naturality to the square over Z and the constructed e,e′,α,β. The source and target structural maps agree with the twice-restricted maps by the projection equations and associativity. Generalize the square commutativity proof before rewriting these equalities, so all dependent types and equality transports are changed together. This gives isomorphisms a,b and the conjugacy equation for the two exact comparison arrows.
Postcompose the original arrow with b.hom, use the conjugacy equation, and cancel a.hom. Mathlib isIso_comp_right_iff and isIso_comp_left_iff give both directions of the asserted equivalence.

theorem singleComplexOpenComparison_nested_isIso_iff
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (h : g' ≫ f = f' ≫ g)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K')
    (W Z : X.Opens) (hZW : Z ≤ W) :
    let hW : pullback.snd g' W.ι ≫ (W.ι ≫ f) =
        (pullback.fst g' W.ι ≫ f') ≫ g := by
      rw [← pullback.condition_assoc, Category.assoc, h, ← Category.assoc]
    let φW : (derivedPullback (pullback.snd g' W.ι)).obj
        ((derivedPullback W.ι).obj K) ⟶
        (derivedPullback (pullback.fst g' W.ι)).obj K' :=
    (((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
      (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition))))
      (pullback.snd g' W.ι) W.ι).hom.app K ≫
    eqToHom (congrArg (fun k ↦ (derivedPullback k).obj K)
      (pullback.condition (f := g') (g := W.ι)).symm) ≫
    ((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
      (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition))))
      (pullback.fst g' W.ι) g').inv.app K ≫
    (derivedPullback (pullback.fst g' W.ι)).map φ)
    IsIso (singleComplexOpenComparison f f' g g' h K K' φ Z) ↔
      IsIso (singleComplexOpenComparison (W.ι ≫ f) (pullback.fst g' W.ι ≫ f')
        g (pullback.snd g' W.ι) hW ((derivedPullback W.ι).obj K)
        ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst g' W.ι)).obj K') φW (W.ι ⁻¹ᵁ Z))
